verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's official CLI documents uploading native debug symbols (dSYM, PDB, ELF) via `glitchtip-cli debug-files upload`, and a release note mentions minidump support, which covers the iOS and native parts of the story. ProGuard mapping upload for Android is never mentioned, and nothing shows how crashes are then symbolicated to function names and lines. missing for 10: ProGuard/R8 mapping upload, documentation of symbolication results (function names/line numbers), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload dSYM, ProGuard, and native debug symbols so mobile and native crashes symbolicate to real function names and lines

citations.quote: Upload debug symbols for native applications (dSYM, PDB, ELF): glitchtip-cli debug-files upload ./build --org my-org --project my-project
Logs, cold storage, MCP and minidump support
